gloss: field and open country follow Strong's def and usage. OSHB lemma 7704 b.

strong: a word; by implication, a matter
gloss: word and thing or matter are Strong's defs. Root from H1696, stated by Strong.

strong: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every
gloss: all, every, whole are Strong's defs. Pos noun per Strong n-m and OSHB Nc.
not and no are Strong's defs. OSHB tags Tn, so no inflection is claimed.
voice and sound; Gen.3.8 hears a sound, Gen.3.10 your voice. Defective קֹל spelling is OSHB's lemma 6963 a.

strong: seed; figuratively, fruit, plant, sowing-time, posterity
gloss: seed matches; offspring is the posterity sense. Root from H2232, stated by Strong.
on, over, against fit Strong's range. Gen.12.20 with the suffix reads concerning him; plural-looking shape is the preposition's.
to and toward are Strong's defs. Citation note records Strong's shortened-form statement.

strong: hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
gloss: from and out of are the defs; than is the comparative use taught in l-min. OSHB's 1cp tag on Gen.2.17 is kept; the sense is from it, and the note says so.
between matches, and Strong itself notes the repetition taught here.

strong: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense
gloss: good matches; pleasing is in usage (pleasant, pleasure).
bad and evil. OSHB splits adjective 7451 b from noun 7451 c, so רָעַת is a derivation.
great and older are defs; big falls under in any sense. Strong gives the defective spelling too.
small and younger from Strong's range. OSHB's 6996 b holam variant is the Genesis form, noted on the card.
living and alive. Strong's noun use is split by OSHB as 2416 c, so חַיַּת is a derivation.
bird matches; flying creatures from often collectively and usage.

strong: especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)
gloss: livestock from usage cattle, large animal from the def.

strong: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body
gloss: flesh and body are Strong's defs.

strong: food (for man or beast), especially bread
gloss: bread and food are the defs. Gender stated as Strong n-m, OSHB common.

strong: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
gloss: silver and money are the defs.
flock matches; sheep and goats is the collective sense. Gender stated as Strong and OSHB differ.
servant matches; slave is the bondman of the usage.
young man and boy from the def and usage young (man); servant from by implication.
people matches; nation from Strong's range. OSHB lemma 5971 a.

strong: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot
gloss: place is the first usage and the widely used sense.

strong: a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
gloss: human being and humankind are the defs. The name is H121, a separate entry with the same letters, and it isn't a card. With the article, Gen.2.7 reads the man.
ground and land are usage; soil is the def.

strong: specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God
gloss: God and gods are Strong's defs. Plural in form per Strong and OSHB.
hear, listen and obey fit Strong's range for this primitive root.
say matches; think and command are the usage list's extensions.
send and stretch out are Strong's senses.
take and receive are in the usage list.
eat and consume are in Strong's range.
lie down matches for the isolated form; the sexual sense is Strong's. Gen.19.34 and Gen.26.10 are sexual, and 26.10's almost comes from כִּמְעַט, not the verb's token.
serve, work and till are in Strong's range. Noun H5650 is separately listed.
pass over and cross are the defs; pass by in Gen.18.5 is contextual.
bury matches.
walk and go are Strong's senses. Strong's akin-to note is in the rootNote.
know matches; euphemism is in Strong's range and is contextual in Gen.4.1.
I matches. Strong gives a contraction of H595. It keeps a card, but the inventory counts both as one lexeme.
